$comment: KS-470 — triaged npm-audit baseline. Every advisory reported by `npm audit` at the workspace root — and (KS-531) every advisory matched against a standalone lockfile by `scripts/audit/audit-locks.mjs` — must either be listed here (with the reason it is accepted and the ticket that recorded the decision) or the gate (scripts/audit/audit-gate.mjs) fails. Entries with `expires` are TEMPORARY exceptions pending a fix ticket — the gate treats them as new once the date passes (the KS-105 ticketed-exception model). Keyed by GHSA id.

GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84.reason: Bundled (vite-plugin-node-polyfills → crypto-browserify → browserify-sign → elliptic, pinned by crypto-browserify's side-effectful createECDH export) but UNREACHABLE: zero createSign/createVerify/createECDH invocations in issuer src, shared, or any @meshsdk/@cardano-sdk file (grep-verified with a positive control); Cardano signing is Ed25519 via libsodium WASM. Chunk is lazy (wallet-connect only). Full working on KS-470.

GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq.reason: Path is @azure/msal-node (m365-integration) → uuid 8.3.2. Advisory covers v3/v5/v6-with-buffer bounds; msal-node's only uuid import is `{ v4 }` (dist/crypto/GuidGenerator.mjs — verified 2026-07-19). The v5.x msal-node copy under @azure/identity resolves uuid outside the vulnerable range.

GHSA-5qjj-4xww-7phc.reason: KS-493 wave: valibot 1.2.0 is bundled by @prisma/dev (Prisma dev-server tooling, pulled transitively via @prisma/client) and is reached only through that path - not through any Secuura runtime code. The @prisma/dev bundle pins it, so a root override is inert; a @prisma/client major bump is the only real fix (out of scope here). Moderate, not runtime-reachable in Secuura code paths. Accepted as a dev/tooling-bundle path (KS-470 precedent).
